_note: Sample business for the gallery. Names, numbers and details are fictional.

business.name: Fenwick Hale
business.headline: Forty-eight homes on the edge of Merri Creek.
business.intro: The Merri is six storeys of one, two and three-bedroom homes in Northcote, set back behind the creek's river red gums. Registrations are open. The display suite opens in February.
business.address: Display suite, 212 High Street, Northcote VIC 3070
business.disclaimer: Sample site made by Oceanalt. Fenwick Hale and The Merri are fictional. Images are for illustration only.

hero.photoAlt: A pale brick and timber building behind trees

credentials.text: All electric, 7.5 star average energy rating

servicesIntro: Every home faces north or east, every balcony is deep enough to eat on, and the floors are oak throughout.

services.name: One bedroom
services.desc: 62 to 70 m² inside and a 9 m² balcony. A study nook, and a bathroom with a window.

services.name: Two bedrooms
services.desc: 82 to 96 m², two bathrooms, and a balcony the width of the living room. Most look over the creek.

services.name: Three bedrooms
services.desc: 118 to 134 m² on the corners, with light from two sides and a separate laundry.

services.name: Garden homes
services.desc: Four ground-floor homes with walled gardens and a gate onto the creek path.

services.name: Penthouses
services.desc: Two on level six, 186 m² each, with a 60 m² terrace over the treetops to the city.

plates.title: Designed from the creek, not the street
plates.intro: Architecture by Aldridge Kemp, landscape by Field Office. Images are artist's impressions.

photos.photoAlt: A dark timber building behind a river red gum at dusk
photos.name: The creek side
photos.caption: Recycled brick, blackbutt battens, every gum kept

photos.photoAlt: A pale living room with a timber wall and full-height windows
photos.name: Two-bedroom living
photos.caption: 2.7 m ceilings, oak floors

photos.photoAlt: An open living room with a timber ceiling opening to a garden
photos.name: Garden home

team.name: Aldridge Kemp
team.bio: Brick, timber and deep window reveals. The brief was a building that looks settled from the creek path on the day it opens.

team.name: Field Office
team.bio: Kept the river red gums on the site and planted the creek edge with species from the Merri Creek corridor.

team.name: Brunt Construction
team.bio: On a fixed-price contract signed before a single home was offered for sale.

team.name: Fenwick Hale
team.bio: Building mid-rise homes in Melbourne's inner north since 2009. We hold a share of every building for ten years after handover.

process.title: Register
process.desc: Leave your details. Floorplans and the price list come to you before they go anywhere else.

process.title: Private preview, February 2027
process.desc: Registered buyers see the display suite first, by appointment, a week before it opens to the public.

process.title: Contracts
process.desc: A 10% deposit, held in trust until settlement. We'll show you where to check the off-the-plan duty concession.

process.title: Building, 2027 to 2028
process.desc: Site updates every quarter, and two hard-hat tours for buyers.

process.title: Settlement, late 2028
process.desc: A walk-through with the site manager before settlement, then your keys.

faq.a: Every two and three-bedroom home has a basement car space with an EV charger. One-bedroom buyers can add a space while they last.

faq.q: What will the owners corporation fees be?
faq.a: Estimated at $3,800 to $6,900 a year, depending on the home. The full budget is in the contract pack.

faq.q: Can I buy to rent it out?
faq.a: Yes. We can introduce you to two local property managers for a rental appraisal.
They're artist's impressions. The finished building and finishes may differ, and the contract sets out exactly what's included.

contactIntro: Floorplans and the full price list go to registered buyers first. We'll call to book a time at the display suite.

contact.note: We only use your details to contact you about The Merri.
